'''Z-X3's faction''' was an army of [[Droid/Legends|droids]] led by [[Z-X3|Zee-Exthree]] that [[Kligson's Moon civil war|fought]] against [[Kligson's faction]] aboard [[Kligson's Moon/Legends|Kligson's Moon]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]].
